gates.name: bounded_authoritative_snapshot
gates.evidence: An exact synthetic Dolibarr query produces a closed provider/tenant/entity/requester/purpose/material-field snapshot with a digest-derived version; hidden, truncated, extra, over-limit, malformed or existing-target state denies.

gates.name: snapshot_derived_display_binding
gates.evidence: The displayed Diff is derived from the validated snapshot and binds requester, purpose, all material changes, data/budget/side-effect impacts, rollback, active Policy and snapshot digest/version into the proposal and lease.

gates.name: approval_and_use_time_freshness
gates.evidence: Fresh state is re-read before the owner decision and before reservation/provider mutation; state/version/Policy/profile drift denies, and durable replay checks run on both sides of the asynchronous use-time read.

gates.name: adversarial_regression_evidence
gates.evidence: Rapid parallel decisions, concurrent effect use, prohibited actor changes, approve-after-reject, tampered snapshot/Diff/authority fields, expiry, replay, restart and readback mismatch probes deny without a duplicate effect.

fullInstallSmoke.rerunJustification: SAFE_DEMO_COLD-01 exposed replay-denial ordering and an adjacent asynchronous reservation race; the second run followed real correcting runtime bytes plus a focused concurrency regression.

nonClaims: No real provider ETag, conditional mutation or transaction isolation was tested or claimed.
No production requester/approver identity, IAM, MFA, quorum, anti-clickjacking or multi-tenant routing was tested or enabled.
The local owner actor and digest-derived version are deterministic fixtures, not production identity or freshness infrastructure.
No push, pull request, merge, tag, release, publication, production deployment or external-system action.
